subject: QuillSecure: hosted consumption shape + peak surge clarifications
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Wang <taylor@quillsecure.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: QuillSecure consumption shape + peak surge clarifications

Hi Taylor — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can put together an initial hosted pricing scenario for your team.

Recap from call:
- Primary use: document summarization + redaction pipeline for user-uploaded documents (production traffic begins after pilot).
- Expected monthly active users: early pilot ~30k, target scale within 6 months.
- Rough token mix: long context prompts (avg 1,800 tokens/request) + short metadata calls.

Asks (short):
1) Monthly token envelope: can you confirm an expected monthly token range (low / expected / high)? Separate prod vs dev/staging buckets if possible.
2) Peak/99th TPS: what is the 99th-percentile TPS you need reserved? Any short spikes (seconds) above that we should know about?
3) Budget target: what is an acceptable $/1M tokens target for you at pilot and at committed volume?

What I'll do next: Karthik will run quick unit-econ scenarios and share a workbook with three slab-based price bands + a latency/reserve recommendation. We can then propose a short pilot commit (30–60 days) and an SLA snapshot.

Attachments: I will send a very small workbook for you to fill in traffic splits (prod/staging) — will attach in my next note.

Thanks — Aisha
--
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Taylor Wang <taylor@quillsecure.com>

Cc: accounts@quillsecure.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: QuillSecure consumption shape + peak surge clarifications

Aisha — great to chat. Answers below (high level) and I attached an internal org note for context.

1) Monthly tokens (rough):
- Low (pilot): 8,000,000 tokens/month
- Expected (Q1 scale): 18,000,000 tokens/month
- High (peak growth): 30,000,000 tokens/month
Breakdown: ~80% production, ~20% staging/dev.

2) Peak/99th TPS:
- 99th: ~120 TPS sustained
- Short spikes: we see bursty behavior up to ~240 TPS for ~20–45 seconds when a batch job completes. Need graceful fallback (retry/fan-out) — we can discuss concurrent throttling.

3) Budget target:
- Pilot: willing to pay up to $1,100 / 1M tokens for short test window if latency is <350ms for typical summary calls.
- Committed target (18–30M): target $750–$900 / 1M tokens depending on SLA and reserved TPS.

Procurement note: accounts@quillsecure.com is watching budget cycles — likely a PO within 30 days after pilot.

Taylor
VP Product — QuillSecure
taylor@quillsecure.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Taylor Wang <taylor@quillsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: QuillSecure consumption shape + peak surge clarifications

Thanks Taylor — helpful numbers. I pulled together a quick cost sketch and a small workbook (attached) to show unit-econ across three commitment bands. High-level notes:

- Assumptions: avg token length 1,800 for summary requests (as discussed), 10% of requests are embeddings (shorter).
- Serving footprint: given 99th=120 TPS with 240 TPS short spikes, recommend reserving a 150 TPS steady reserve for pilot and enable burst up to 250 TPS with our automatic fallbacks. This keeps tail latency predictable and caps infra cost.

Quick unit-econ (rounded):
- Pilot band (0–10M/mo): list price suggestion $1,200 / 1M tokens — unit margin conservatively thin but allows rapid onboarding and smaller infra reserves.
- Mid band (10–25M/mo): suggested $950 / 1M tokens with a 99th TPS reserve of 150 and burst policy included.
- Committed band (25M+): suggested $720 / 1M tokens for contractual commits (12-month).

Estimated hosted monthly bill examples (inc. infra surcharge/proxy):
- 8M tokens @ $1,200 = $9,600
- 18M tokens @ $950 = $17,100
- 30M tokens @ $720 = $21,600

Notes on latency: with the recommended reserve and batching profile we expect median <200–300ms for typical summary calls; large-context tail could be higher — we can instrument exact distributions in the pilot.

Attached: QuillSecure_MVP_traffic.xlsx — fill the green cells with your expected daily peak windows and percentage prod/dev split. That will let me refine the TPS sizing and cost curves.

Next steps: if this aligns, Aisha can propose a pilot commit + SLA snapshot and we can involve procurement.

-Karthik
Principal SE | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Proposed immediate plan:

- SLA snapshot: we'll share a short SLA-draft (attached) covering uptime, latency targets, and rollback policies during spike events.
- Mutual action plan: Taylor to confirm PO window by 2026-03-20; Redwood to provision pilot pool and deliver instrumentation dashboard within 3 business days of PO.

Please review attached SLA-draft-v1.pdf and the workbook Karthik attached. If the pricing bands look broadly acceptable, I will get a short SOW and pilot purchase order template over to accounts@quillsecure.com.
